decisions.reason: After surviving its first full market phase, this spraying system appears close enough to aspiration levels within the firm's core competence that a medium-sized German machinery producer would keep it and continue learning from customer demand.
As an incremental pump product very near the established offer, it likely meets or exceeds internal aspiration levels and is therefore unlikely to be withdrawn.
A multi-model transfer-pump line reflects committed resources and broad fit with existing applications, so with no clear sign of underperformance the firm would keep it.

Although still early and therefore more uncertain, this hydraulic two-component spraying system is close to the core business and the firm's innovation slack in a growing industry supports retaining it unless results fall clearly below aspiration.
